hero.sub:
Premium streetwear
for those who move
with intention

products.name: Night Spine Hoodie
products.desc: Our signature heavyweight hoodie — oversized dropped-shoulder fit, kangaroo pocket and a double-lined hood. Available in Black and White.
products.fabric: 380gsm heavyweight cotton fleece, brushed interior. Machine wash cold, inside out. Hang dry to preserve the print.

products.name: Shadow Ninja Tee
products.desc: Oversized unisex tee with a boxy dropped-shoulder fit and a reinforced collar that keeps its shape. Available in Black and White.
products.fabric: 240gsm premium combed cotton. Pre-shrunk. Machine wash cold, inside out. Soft water-based print that won't crack.

products.name: Box Fit T-Shirt
products.desc: Boxy oversized fit in premium mesh fabric — breathable, structured and built for everyday movement. Available in Sky Blue and Black.
products.fabric: Premium mesh fabric — lightweight and breathable. Machine wash cold, inside out. Hang dry.

products.name: Pleated Pant
products.desc: Pleated wide-leg trouser with a clean drape and relaxed, elongating silhouette. A smart-casual staple that pairs with tees and knits alike. Available in Khaki and Black.
products.fabric: Premium wrinkle-resistant suiting fabric with a soft drape. Machine wash cold or dry clean. Warm iron if needed.
